'''Axion''' was an individual who was elected as [[Consul/Legends|Consul]] in the newly established [[Zakuulan government|independent government]] of the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]]<ref name="future" /> in [[3628 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|5.9}}</ref> following [[Vinn Atrius]]' [[Order of Zildrog campaign|campaign]] against the [[Eternal Alliance]], which saw the Alliance lose its influence in the galaxy after the destruction of the [[Eternal Fleet]] and the ''[[Gravestone]]'', their most powerful weapons.<ref name="Nathema">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=flashpoint|The Nathema Conspiracy}}</ref>

In [[3628 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the newly appointed Consul Axion sent a message to the [[Alliance Commander]], stating that Zakuul would be withdrawing from the Eternal Alliance. Axion also condemned Vinn Atrius's actions against the Eternal Alliance, but also admitted that, like Atrius, many on Zakuul also held the same resentment towards the Alliance. Axion assured the Commander that they would most likely relinquish control of any colony worlds gained by the Eternal Empire and seek alliances with other worlds instead. Axion ended the message by saying that he hoped that the Alliance and Zakuul could negotiate a trade agreement beneficial to both governments.<ref name="future" />

==Behind the scenes==
Axion was mentioned in "The future," a codex entry for [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', specifically the<ref name="future" /> [[2018]]<ref name="Nathema Release Date">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/05032018/game-update-5.9-nathema-conspiracy|text=Game Update 5.9: The Nathema Conspiracy Patch Notes}}</ref> 5.9 ''The Nathema Conspiracy'' update to the [[2016]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] expansion.<ref name="future" />
